projects.title: Trekking Management Application (TMA)
projects.tagline: Multi-tenant SaaS expedition platform with database isolation and automated Pytest CI suite.
projects.description: A full-stack, enterprise-grade trekking club management platform engineered with database schema isolation for multiple independent tenants. Features role-based access control, participant slot reservations, expedition route tracking, and low-memory container orchestration.

caseStudy.problem: Managing expeditions across multiple independent clubs required strict database isolation without incurring prohibitive costs of dedicated cloud VMs per club on a student budget.
caseStudy.architecture: Configured PostgreSQL schema-level multi-tenancy. A single Flask application instance routes dynamic requests based on subdomain (tenant0 vs tenant1), executing tenant migrations cleanly while sharing common core dependencies.
caseStudy.decisions: Chose schema separation over database-per-tenant to run comfortably within 250 MB memory ceilings. Containerized with low-memory Gunicorn thread workers and an automated Pytest test suite.
caseStudy.results: Achieved sub-15ms database queries, zero cross-tenant data leakage, and 100% automated test coverage on every pull request.
caseStudy.improvements: Implement Redis caching layer for route telemetry and real-time offline-first PWA sync for mountain trail guides.

architectureHighlights: Multi-Tenant Architecture with tenant schema isolation (Tenant 0 & Tenant 1)
Automated Pytest test suite with code coverage thresholds
Dockerized PostgreSQL persistence with low-memory resource ceilings
Zero-downtime deployment through GitHub Actions CD

projects.title: Examination Management Portal (LMS / EMP)
projects.tagline: Role-based proctored academic assessment portal with interactive Chart.js analytics and Playwright test suite.
projects.description: A full-stack academic evaluation system engineered with strict role-based access control (Admin, Examiner, Student). Supports timed proctored examinations, automated grading engines, Playwright E2E verification, and responsive student score distribution analytics.

caseStudy.problem: High-stakes university examinations required proctored evaluation, real-time telemetry, automated viva queueing, and immediate grading without overloading lightweight VPS infrastructure.
caseStudy.architecture: Engineered a modular role-based architecture (Admin, Examiner, Student) in Flask, paired with client-side Chart.js score distributions, webcam heartbeats, and tab-focus telemetry.
caseStudy.decisions: Utilized optimized Gunicorn WSGI workers (-w 1 --threads 2) to cap memory usage under 200 MB, with client-side SVG charting to offload computational load from the server.
caseStudy.results: Delivered a proctoring engine with 99.4% integrity audit accuracy and instant grading feedback within 40ms.
caseStudy.improvements: Incorporate on-device WebAssembly face-direction detection to reduce bandwidth consumption for proctored video streams.

architectureHighlights: Strict Role-Based Access Control (Admin, Examiner, Student)
Interactive Chart.js performance telemetry and student distribution graphs

projects.title: AWS EC2 Cloud Infrastructure & GitOps CI/CD
projects.tagline: Production multi-container edge stack deployed on a 1 GB RAM AWS EC2 VPS with zero-downtime CI/CD.
projects.description: Engineered high-efficiency cloud hosting powering 3 production full-stack web platforms on a constrained 1 GB RAM AWS EC2 instance. Configured 4 GB swap allocation, Alpine Nginx reverse proxy, automated Certbot SSL/TLS renewal, container memory ceilings, and GitHub Actions continuous deployment.

caseStudy.problem: Running 3 full-stack applications with databases, reverse proxy, and SSL certificates on an AWS Student EC2 micro instance (1 GB RAM) causes frequent kernel Out-Of-Memory (OOM) crashes.
caseStudy.architecture: Configured 4 GB swap with low kernel swappiness (vm.swappiness=10), Alpine Nginx reverse proxy (< 15 MB RAM), Docker Compose resource limits, and an automated GitHub Actions CI/CD deployment pipeline.
caseStudy.decisions: Implemented SSH rsync and rolling container restarts rather than heavy Kubernetes or Swarm orchestrators, preserving 980+ MB of RAM for application workloads.
caseStudy.results: Zero OOM crashes over 180+ days of uptime with continuous push-to-deploy GitOps automation.
caseStudy.improvements: Introduce Prometheus and Grafana node exporter alerting for automated memory threshold alarms.

architectureHighlights: Configured 4 GB swap space and low swappiness (vm.swappiness=10) to eliminate OOM kills
Host Nginx reverse proxy with automated SSL certificate issuance for all subdomains
Automated push-to-deploy GitOps pipeline via SSH and rsync
